title: Full-mode implementation and evaluation of the 3GPP 256-NCA4, 256-NCA5 and 256-NCA6 algorithms for 6G: code and data
description: Code, raw measurement data and analysis scripts for the paper Full-Mode Implementation of the 3GPP 256-NCA4, 256-NCA5 and 256-NCA6 Algorithms for 6G: Packet-Size, Energy and Constant-Time Evaluation on Microcontroller, ARM, x86 and FPGA (submitted to Cyber Security and Applications). The package implements 256-NEA, 256-NIA and 256-NCA with Snow 5G, AES-256 and ZUC-256 at several optimization levels, measures them on an ESP32, a Raspberry Pi 5, an AMD Zen 4 processor and a Spartan-7 FPGA, and contains every raw result file and the scripts that produce every figure and table. The 3GPP specifications, their reference code and their test data are not included.
